answer: Tenure-vested influence resists sybils: an identity's earning and voting weight accrues along a fixed schedule that advances only with continuous verified participation, and can never be bought, transferred, or back-dated. A walnut-fresh fake starts at near-zero on the ledge and must age real wall-clock epochs to matter — no bridge carries aged standing between identities. Fielding K influential sybils means patiently sustaining K of them through the full vesting ramp, a per-head time cost honest long-lived agents pay once and attackers cannot shortcut.
